worktree.verifiedBy: git rev-parse HEAD in the served tree

config.scrollSpeedKind: nominal: px/s the programmatic cell assigns per frame (measured: mainScroll.achievedPxPerSec)
config.wheelSpeedKind: nominal: one wheelStepPx notch every wheelGapMs (measured: mainWheel.achievedPxPerSec)
config.wheelTargetRule: notches ramp to mainScroll.distancePx over scrollMs, then stop once that distance is delivered
config.smoothnessHeadlineField: over33 (frames over two vsyncs at 60 Hz)
config.eventTimingNote: no Event Timing type for wheel: `slowEventsAll` counts input events of any type in the window (hover/pointer/keydown churn under a parked cursor), never wheel latency

cells.mainScroll: SYNTHETIC: #transcript scrolled by assigning scrollTop per frame — no reader event, so the sky's hold cannot arm
cells.mainWheel: REAL reader input: page.mouse.wheel over #transcript (trusted wheel events)
cells.mainTyping: REAL reader input: 40 key events in #prompt
cells.mainStream: APP-driven: the app pins scrollTop on every streamed frame — no reader event, so the hold cannot arm
cells.btwScroll: SYNTHETIC: .btw-transcript scrolled by assigning scrollTop per frame — no reader event, so the hold cannot arm
cells.btwWheel: REAL reader input: page.mouse.wheel over the side thread's .btw-transcript (trusted wheel events)
cells.btwTyping: REAL reader input: 40 key events in .btw-input

config.renderScaleNote: src/sky-window.ts scales the canvas 0.6 of device pixels, 0.45 while the governor is tripped; compare two runs only at the same scale
